CLE won 3 of 4 factors: shooting, second chances, getting to the line. Effective FG% 64.1 to 46.3.
Biggest swing: Donovan Mitchell makes 27-foot running pullup jump shot (Darius Garland assists) (Q1 11:24), +5 points of CLE win probability.
Best CLE lineup (4+ minutes): Mitchell, Allen, Garland, Mobley, Okoro, +12 in 8:20.
